# AGAD Zbiór Popielów 17, no. 042, Deboli to Stanisław August, St Petersburg 10 May 1789, k. 138-142v
# Scans: http://agadd2.home.net.pl/metrykalia/12/album/17/index.html images 0173 (k.138r), 0174 (k.138v-139r), 0175 (k.139v-140r), 0176 (k.140v-141r), 0177 (k.141v), 0178 (k.142r), 0179 (k.142v; right page blank)
# One token per number group. A letter written under a group is appended (355a). ? = unsure reading. "bo" = a small two-loop sign under a group.
# Hand as in no. 109: 5 like "s", 6 like "b", 8 a crossed/looped 0 ("θ"), 9 like "q"; plain 0 and 8 often hard to tell apart; the initial 1 is
# often a hooked "c"; a pair of minims can be 11 or a u-shaped 4. No clear words inside the cipher; no 4000 9933 runs.
# Clear: heading "Sire!" on k.138r; close on k.142v: "Je suis avec le plus profond Respect / Sire / De Votre Majesté" /
# "St Petersbourg / ce 10. May. 1789" / "le très humble, très / obéissant fidel sujet / et serviteur Deboli".
# Catchwords (not tokens): 1578 (k.138r), 1786 (k.138v), 2046 (k.139r), 1353 (k.139v), 1567 (k.140r; the last 7 looks like a 4 at first sight),
# "1429 6" (k.140v; k.141r opens 1429 10), 1657 (k.141r), 1317 (k.141v), 1578 (k.142r).
# Hand as in c109: 5 like "s", 6 like "b", 8 a crossed 0 ("θ"), 9 like "q"; plain 0 and θ (8) often hard to tell apart,
# so final 0/8 readings lean on the series vocabulary (e.g. 35θ = 358, 157θ = 1578, 149θ = 1498, 144θ = 1448).
# k.138r: pencil foliation 138 (old number 159 struck at top right). Heading in clear: "Sire!". Strong bleed-through from k.138v.
# Catchword (not a token): 1578 at the foot of k.138r.
# k.138r 01 "10 31": written "10.31" with a clear dot, read as two groups (could be 1031).
# k.138r 12 "1 784": written "1.784" with a dot after the 1 (could be one group 1784?).
# k.138r 20 last group 247 and 21 first group 247? (first digit looks like 4, i.e. 447/427?) are underlined; the underline on 21
# runs from 247? through 1268? (247? 1873 1218 1268?). The group repeats across the line break.
# k.138r 19 "1762e?": the letter under 1762 is an o-like loop, read as e.
# k.138r 16 "1144b": the last 4 is raised and a b written under it.
# k.138r right margin: a small "b" beside line 11 and ":"-like marks beside lines 4, 13-16 at the page edge (probably
# bleed-through or binding marks; not tokens).
# k.138v (left page of image 0174): no foliation; no clear text. Catchword (not a token): 1786 at the foot (= first group of k.139r).

# written under these groups (three times under 1404). It sits between the lines; read as belonging to the group above it.
# k.138v 02 "1363c": a short horizontal stroke under the c (start of the 03 underline? or a separate mark).
# k.138v 01 "904?": last digit blotted. 02 "1590?": final 0 has an a-like tail.
# k.138v 11 "1924a": the a under the dot after 1924 is itself underlined. 09 "1094a": the a is underlined too.
# k.138v 14 "881e" and "1404e": the small letter under the group is e-like (could be c).
# k.138v 22 ends "10 [dash]": a long line-filling dash after 10.
# k.139r (right page of image 0174): pencil foliation 139 (old number 150 struck). No clear text.
# Catchword (not a token): 2046 at the foot of k.139r, below the last line.
# k.139r underlining in the original: 22 a wavy line under 1653a ... 1775 (1653a 1874 1426 1266 1343 943 153 1775);
# 23 straight underline under 948 1432 1206 (and a short stroke under the c of 1354c); 24 underlined throughout;
# 25 underlined 153 ... 2076 1432 and 1445 (gap under 2011b); 26 underlined 11 637 8 1654 1248; 27 underlined 912 ... 1194b
# and 82 ... 2059; 28 underlined 895 ... 912a, 1448 870 and 2046. A long underlined passage, 22-28.
# k.139r 19: a curved stroke under 1681 1657 (tie or start of an underline). 20: a small loop above 407 (stray mark?).
# k.139r 07 "18b": the b under 18 is itself underlined.
# Hand note for this page: the initial 1 is often a hooked "c" joined to the next digit, and a pair of minims ("u")
# can be 11 or 4; readings 1110, 1160?, 140?, 1188?, 1108?, 1811? depend on this.
# k.138v 31 "1186a?": written with a hooked initial (1 + c-like 1 + 8 + 6); could be 1086a.
# k.138v 07 and k.139r 10 "1448?": written like 1498 (4 as u/q), but it is the recurring 1653/1654 5 870 1319 1448 phrase.
# 0/8: a bold looped/crossed o is read as 8, a plain o as 0; where the vocabulary decides (1452, 1021, 728, 928, 1988, 688) it is marked ? if the shape disagrees.
